newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cert coffee stocks off 9,070 bags Jan 10 week.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cert coffee stocks off 9,070 bags Jan 10 week.

text.p: U.S. certified coffee stocks fell by 9,070 60-kg bags in the week ended January 10, to 23,388 bags, the Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange reported on Monday.
There were no bags pending grading or recertification, the CSCE said.

The bulk of the drawdown occurred in the exchange's Miami warehouses, where stocks declined by 7,250 bags to 17,519 bags. Stocks in New Orleans fell by 574 bags, to 5,336 bags, while New York stock were down 225 bags, to 553 bags.
Traders said the latest drawdown was unexpected and could be slightly bullish for coffee futures.
"I am surprised for this time of year given the new crops coming in," one trader said. "If anything it is a positive number. We could get a pop tomorrow."
